item.title: Democrats Confused Why Venezuelans Cheering Downfall Of Nice, Warm Collectivism
item.description: U.S. — Bewildered Democrats watched in utter confusion today as Venezuelans cheered the downfall of warm, cozy collectivism.

item.title: Classic: Trump Has Delta Force Operators Tell Maduro ‘You’re Fired’
item.description: CARACAS — In a classic Trump move, the President ordered the Delta Force operators who captured Venezuelan dictator Nicolas Maduro to say "You're fired" upon deposing him.

item.title: Aides Tell Disappointed Trump That Maduro And Mamdani Are Different People
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — President Trump was crushed today when aides informed him that Maduro and Mamdani are, in fact, different people.

item.title: Sad: This Man Didn't Check The News For One Hour And Missed The Entirety Of World War III
item.description: SPOKANE, WA — Local man Travis Barnes sadly failed to check his phone for one hour, missing out on the entirety of World War III.
